description_en: Queries the connection status, last connection time, cumulative usage duration, and session persistence duration of users
description_zh: 查询用户的连接状态、最近连接时间、累计使用时长和会话保持时长
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center query-user-usage-report --app-instance-group-id 'aig-9ciijz60n4xsv****' --page-size 100 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-date '2026-09-01 00:00:00' --end-date '2026-09-02 00:00:00' --product-type CloudApp --user-id user01 --connection-status Connected --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryUserUsageReport

parameters.help_en: The ID of the app instance group. This parameter is used to filter data for a specified app instance group. You can call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain the ID. If you do not specify this parameter, data is not filtered by app instance group
parameters.help_zh: 交付组 ID，用于筛选指定交付组的数据。可调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 获取；不传时不按交付组筛选
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 200. If the value is greater than 1,500, it is processed as 1,500
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数。不传时默认 200；大于 1500 时按 1500 处理
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. Specify a value starting from 1. If you do not specify this parameter, the service processes the request as the first page, but the response may return 0
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的页码。建议从 `1` 开始显式传入；不传时服务按首页处理，但响应可能回显 `0`
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the business region. This parameter is used to filter report data. You can call the [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务地域 ID，用于筛选报表数据。可调用 [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) 获取
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the statistics. Required. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The service converts the time to `yyyyMMdd` and calculates the statistics by natural days in a closed interval. The hours, minutes, and seconds are not involved in the day-level filtering. The time span cannot exceed 60 months. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted as Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8)
parameters.help_zh: 统计开始时间，必填。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`。服务会转换为 `yyyyMMdd` 后按自然日闭区间统计，时分秒不参与日粒度筛选。时间跨度不能超过 60 个月。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end time of the statistics. Required. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The end time cannot be earlier than StartDate. The service converts the time to `yyyyMMdd` and calculates the statistics by natural days in a closed interval. The hours, minutes, and seconds are not involved in the day-level filtering. The time span cannot exceed 60 months. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted as Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8)
parameters.help_zh: 统计结束时间，必填。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，且不能早于 `StartDate`。服务会转换为 `yyyyMMdd` 后按自然日闭区间统计，时分秒不参与日粒度筛选。时间跨度不能超过 60 个月。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Required.

Valid values:

`CloudApp`: WUYING Cloud App.
`CloudBrowser`: Cloud Browser.
`WuyingServer`: Enterprise Edition workstation.
`WuyingWorkstation`: Personal Edition Linggou container workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`: Team Edition Linggou container workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`: Dedicated Edition Linggou container workstation.
`AndroidCloud`: Cloud Phone.
`AIAgent`: AgentBay (AI agent)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。必填。

取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用。
`CloudBrowser`：云浏览器。
`WuyingServer`：企业版工作站。
`WuyingWorkstation`：个人版灵构容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`：灵构团队版容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`：灵构专属版容器工作站。
`AndroidCloud`：云手机。
`AIAgent`：AgentBay（AI 智能体）
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the end user. This parameter is used to accurately filter users. If you do not specify this parameter, data is not filtered by user
parameters.help_zh: 终端用户 ID，用于精确筛选用户；不传时不按用户筛选
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition for the user connection status. The value is not case-sensitive. An unrecognized value is equivalent to not filtering by connection status.

Valid values:

`Connected`: At least one currently connected session exists.
`Disconnected`: The session binding is retained, but no currently connected session exists.
`Unbound`: No session binding exists
parameters.help_zh:
用户连接状态筛选条件，取值不区分大小写。无法识别的值等同于不按连接状态筛选。

取值：

`Connected`：至少存在一个当前已连接会话。
`Disconnected`：仍保留会话绑定，但当前没有已连接会话。
`Unbound`：当前没有会话绑定
parameters.name: connection_status

Code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates that the request is successful. Other values indicate that the request failed
Code.description_zh: 业务状态码。`200` 表示请求处理成功；其他值表示处理失败

Count.description_en: The total number of records that meet the query conditions
Count.description_zh: 满足查询条件的记录总数

Message.description_en: The description of the request processing result. Typically, success is returned when the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 请求处理结果说明。请求成功时通常返回 `success`

PageNumber.description_en: The page number corresponding to the current response

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page used in the current response
PageSize.description_zh: 本次响应采用的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题

UserUsageReportDataModel.description_en: The list of user usage data, sorted in descending order of cumulative usage duration
UserUsageReportDataModel.description_zh: 用户使用情况数据列表，按累计使用时长降序排列

items.description_zh: 用户使用情况数据对象

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the app instance group to which the user usage record belongs
AppInstanceGroupId.description_zh: 用户使用记录所属的交付组 ID

AppInstanceGroupName.description_en: The name of the app instance group to which the user usage record belongs
AppInstanceGroupName.description_zh: 用户使用记录所属的交付组名称

ConnectionStatus.description_en:
The current connection status of the user.

Valid values:

`Connected`: At least one currently connected session exists.
`Disconnected`: The session binding is retained, but no currently connected session exists.
`Unbound`: No session binding exists
ConnectionStatus.description_zh:
用户当前连接状态。

取值：

`Connected`：至少存在一个当前已连接会话。
`Disconnected`：仍保留会话绑定，但当前没有已连接会话。
`Unbound`：当前没有会话绑定

LastConnectedTime.description_en: The last connection time. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. If no current or historical connection record exists, - is returned. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted as Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8)
LastConnectedTime.description_zh: 最近一次连接时间，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`；没有当前或历史连接记录时返回 `-`。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释

RegionId.description_en: The current version does not return a valid region ID. Callers should not rely on this field. To filter by business region, use the BizRegionId request parameter
RegionId.description_zh: 当前版本不返回有效的地域 ID，调用方不应依赖该字段；如需按业务地域筛选，请使用请求参数 `BizRegionId`

SessionsHoldDuration.description_en: The cumulative session persistence duration within the query range. This is the duration during which the user occupies the session from session attach to session release. Multiple sessions under the same app instance group are accumulated. Unit: hours
SessionsHoldDuration.description_zh: 查询范围内累计的会话保持时长，即用户从绑定到会话释放期间占用会话的时长；同一交付组下的多个会话累加。单位：小时

UsageDuration.description_en: The cumulative user usage duration within the query range. The usage duration of the same user under the same app instance group is aggregated by day. Unit: hours
UsageDuration.description_zh: 查询范围内累计的用户使用时长，同一用户在同一交付组下按日汇总。单位：小时

UserId.description_en: The ID of the end user
